messages:
rowan: FYI prod alert - several customers hit SDK crash. root cause looks like fncall return shape drift (array -> envelope object). opening thread to coordinate a quick compatibility fix
ashley: ugh. which route/fn? any sanitized examples we can share to patch the SDK?
rowan: route=order-ingest, fn=normalize_items. observed payload: ```json
[ { "id": "sku_123", "qty": 2 }, { "id": "sku_456", "qty": 1 } ]
```
expected by SDK: ```json
{ "items": [ { "id": "sku_123", "qty": 2 } ] }
```
ops-bot: :bangbang: Alert: downstream_client_errors for order-ingest spiked to 24 at 4876500008. See https://internal/redwood/alerts/1234
pm-jules: customer-impacting. can we do a fast rollback or a routing compat transform? support needs example payloads surfaced in console to triage quickly
dev-sam: quick mitigations: (1) router transform that wraps top-level arrays into {items: <array>} when route opt-in enabled; (2) telemetry flagging coercion_applied so we can monitor. longer-term: per-route strictness + schema gating
ashley: +1. also add coercion_type in telemetry e.g. array_to_envelope. dashboard should be able to pivot by coercion_type and validation_state. set alert: coercion_rate > 0.5% over 10m pages
rowan: agree. console change: sampled_payload peek column and a sandboxed replay button (strict=true / strict=false) for support. must be permissioned and scrub PII
ops-bot: Note: sampled payload capture must follow PII scrub & retention policy: https://internal/redwood/policies/event-capture
dev-sam: router PR incoming with feature flag ROUTER_COMPAT_MODE. transform snippet: ```yaml
route_overrides:
  order-ingest:
    compat_mode: true
    coercion_rules:
      - match: fncall_output_is_array
        action: wrap_with: { "items": $value }
        telemetry_tag: array_to_envelope
```
rowan: can we ship within the hour? customers on paid tiers impacted
dev-sam: opening PR now, small change + unit tests. will include opt-in flag and sampling tag
dev-sam: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pulls/4890
ops-bot: Deploy bot: compat transform deployed to eu-west-1 at 4876500024 by deploy-ci. status: success :white_check_mark:
rowan: downstream errors dropped to 3 in 10m after deploy. SDK team confirms crash no longer repros on repro harness. thanks
pm-jules: follow-ups: (A) notify affected customers, (B) add dashboard panel for coercion_type and validation_state, (C) schedule schema-hardening & CI compatibility tests. UX: hide sampled payload peek behind permission and show a "scrubbed" badge
ashley: I'll add coercion_type to eventv2 and wire dashboard dims. will also emit telemetry field coercion_applied=true when transform runs
rowan: let's add an SDK compatibility CI check that pulls a small sampled payload set and asserts contract. would have caught this earlier
dev-sam: will add telemetry & dashboard PRs and link here. ops, please confirm paging thresholds for coercion alerts
ops-bot: Reminder: close incident ticket when postmortem attached. Incident INC-2026
rowan: closing loop - compat transform live, customers notified, SDK fix in progress. will follow up with postmortem and planned schema rollout. thanks all :pray:
